facts.what: 客人十点三十一敲门，比约定早十四分钟
facts.anchor: My guest isn’t due for another fourteen, to be precise

facts.what: 停掉 Stevie Nicks 黑胶并改播 YouTube 舒缓歌单
facts.anchor: I lift the remote for the television, bring it to life, and push the YouTube button

facts.what: 认为在自己家也像冒牌货、骗子；按太阳穴并有头颅爆炸的自伤想法
facts.anchor: Even in the comfort of my own home, I’m nothing but an imposter. A fraud.

facts.what: 不确定来客该叫客户还是顾客，担心吐在客户身上
facts.anchor: Or is it a customer? I’m still not too sure what to call people who come to visit

facts.what: 忆起十五岁滑冰场被边缘化、其他女孩藏四分之一瓶伏特加
facts.anchor: They had no qualms about smuggling quarter bottles of vodka in their backpacks

facts.what: 三十年来生日愿望是修好自己；发现 Finlay Munro 门外踱步
facts.anchor: The same wish has trumped any other for many of my thirty years.

facts.what: 做这份事业是生死攸关，曾盼睡后不再醒
facts.anchor: For me, it was a matter of life or death. I no longer wanted to go to sleep at night, wishing I’d never open my eyes again.

facts.what: 开门后令她几乎跌退的是他的样子而非风
facts.anchor: But it’s not the wild nip of the air that almost sends me flying, it’s the sight of him.

relations: Cassie 尚未与门外的 Finlay Munro 正式会面；来客属于她的新事业
